question: We're a contract manufacturer making a lipstick with D&C Red No. 21. Does 82.1321 restrict that use or set a limit?
answer: The color additive D&C Red No. 21 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1321 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter. [1]
